name: VirtualList
description: Fixed-row-height virtualized listbox that only renders the visible slice of a large item array.

attributes.label-key: field from object records; default label
attributes.label: string

accessibility.selection: aria-activedescendant only points to a rendered option
accessibility.security: labels are rendered using textContent, not innerHTML

performance.algorithm: fixed-size rows with overscan and top/bottom spacer elements
performance.expectedDom: proportional to viewportHeight/itemHeight, not total item count
performance.notes: does not support dynamic row heights yet
performance.reuse: Overlapping row nodes reused within the current window; scroll and resize coalesced via requestAnimationFrame; pending frame cancelled on disconnect.
